description: Energy System Transformation Model (ESTRAM) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Leibniz Universität Hannover. An energy-system model registered on the Open Energy Platform. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Methodical focus: optimization. Time resolution: hour. Spatial resolution: federal states, regions. Software: Python. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.

outputs: Subject to optimization is both the investment into and the dispatch of energy system components c. An investment decision is made once for each component while the dispatch is optimized for each time step t. We model Germany as a single node (no transport of commodities, e.g. copper plate for the carrier electricity) and in an hourly resolution, resulting in 8760 time steps t for a full year.
